The royal guests to whom due hospitality bad been shown,

King Dasaraths attended the departure of his guests and then 
re-entered the capital in a procession preceded by the holy 
brahmins. 
Rishyasrinsa with his wife Shanta then took leave of the 
monarch and departed to his own city, King Dasaraths accom-
panying him for aome distance. Then the king, expectins to
